subject: Next steps: Vendor questionnaire kickoff & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope (Crescent Health)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Amy Gold <amy.gold@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Vendor questionnaire kickoff & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope (Crescent Health)

Hi Amy — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a shared plan: 

Call recap (30m):
- Goal: complete vendor security intake and determine whether SIG, CAIQ, or Crescent's custom intake is preferred; confirm SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR scope.
- Participants: Amy (Security), Crescent procurement (intro pending), Priya/Karthik/Sean (Redwood sales + security liaison)

Immediate asks for Crescent:
1) Which questionnaire do you prefer we complete for this engagement: Consensus SIG (full), CAIQ, or your custom vendor intake? (If custom, please attach.)
2) Current SOC status: is there an existing SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 Type I / in-progress? Target date if in progress.
3) Is PHI expected to be sent to Redwood or only de-identified data? (This will determine BAA requirements.)
4) Any specific evidence artifacts you want first (encryption-at-rest config, IAM policy export, patching cadence, SOC 2 scoping doc, etc.)

What Redwood will do next:
- I will attach a prefill of the SIG spreadsheet (attached) with answers that map to the services we discussed — we can convert to CAIQ if that is your preference.
- If Crescent prefers CAIQ, we can convert the prefill and return within 2 business days of confirmation.
- If PHI is in scope, we will loop Legal to get a BAA draft; otherwise we'll proceed with standard data processing and controls evidence.

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-20270820.xlsx (prefill of Consensus SIG), reference checklist

Requesting a confirmation on items 1–3 and a point of contact for procurement (to route any contract/PO questions). Proposed owner at Crescent for questionnaire work: security@crescenthealth.com.

Proposed timeline:
- Crescent confirms preferred questionnaire and point of contact: by Mon 2027-08-23
- Redwood returns prefilled questionnaire or CAIQ conversion: within 2 business days after confirmation
- Evidence exchange & follow-up clarifying Qs: week of 2027-08-30

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Amy Gold <amy.gold@crescenthealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: security@crescenthealth.com, procurement@crescenthealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: Vendor questionnaire kickoff & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope (Crescent Health)

Thanks Priya — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Questionnaire: We prefer CAIQ for vendors that integrate at the platform level; however we can accept a SIG prefill if you attach the converted CAIQ mapping. If needed, we'll send our custom intake but CAIQ is most convenient.

2) SOC status: Crescent currently has SOC 2 Type II in-progress; Type I completed earlier this year. Target for Type II completion is 2027-12-15. If you need interim assurance, we can provide the SOC 2 Type I report and a controls remediation plan.

3) PHI / HIPAA: Yes — there is a subset of workflows where PHI will flow to vendor systems (patient matching service). We will require a BAA. We'll need to get legal involved after civility checks but procurement should coordinate.

4) Evidence ask: please include your encryption-at-rest configuration and KMS usage, access control (list of roles + an exported IAM policy), and network segmentation diagram. If you have a standard security architecture diagram we can start with that.

I attached Crescent_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf — it captures some of our procurement fields (we still prefer CAIQ mapping though). Procurement contact is procurement@crescenthealth.com. Security contact is security@crescenthealth.com.

Timeline from Crescent: if Redwood can return a CAIQ-converted prefill by Wed 2027-08-25 EOD, procurement can open a formal intake ticket and route BAA + contracting in the following week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Amy

--
Amy Gold
Head of Security Operations | Crescent Health
amy.gold@crescenthealth.com | 617-555-0199
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Amy Gold <amy.gold@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Vendor questionnaire kickoff & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope (Crescent Health)

Amy — thanks for the clarifications and for attaching the intake form. A few follow-ups so we align on deliverables: 

1) We'll convert the attached SIG prefill into CAIQ and return by Wed 2027-08-25 EOD as requested. If we hit any item that requires a longer internal review (legal evidence, encryption key-holder details), we'll flag it immediately.

2) PHI in scope / BAA: understood. I'll route this to Legal and confirm an expected turnaround for a BAA draft. Can you confirm the initial BAA recipient at Crescent (legal@crescenthealth.com or procurement@crescenthealth.com)?

3) Evidence — we will prioritize providing: 
   - Encryption at rest: KMS usage/export + high-level config note (attachment or link)
   - IAM: roles export + short description of least-privilege enforcement
   - Network: high-level segmentation diagram (redacted for public internet)
   - SOC 2: we will share our latest Type I and our internal SOC 2 roadmap; if needed we can provide SOC 2 supporting artifacts under an NDA/secure share link.

4) Sensitive data flow question (quick): Can you confirm whether Redwood will store direct patient identifiers in production for the integration, or will Crescent provide pseudonymized IDs? This affects scoping for our controls evidence.

Attachments (for Crescent): redwood-sig-prefill-20270820.xlsx (attached) — this is our initial mapping to SIG controls. If you prefer we return as CAIQ, we will do that conversion prior to sending.

Next steps: 
- Crescent confirms BAA recipient and whether pseudonymization will be used: asap (procurement window this week)
- Redwood returns CAIQ conversion + evidentiary plan: Wed 2027-08-25 EOD

I'll follow up with Legal and Karthik will support evidence collection.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Vendor questionnaire kickoff & SOC 2 / HIPAA scope (Crescent Health)

Quick internal note — loop Legal on the BAA ASAP. If Crescent wants interim assurance before Type II is ready we can offer Type I + compensating controls (encryption proofs, network segmentation screenshots, SOC remediation roadmap). I'll draft a short package we can hand to procurement to keep procurement moving.

— Sean
